title: TUI Correctness & Safety — Audit Backlog (May 2026)
description: TUI Correctness & Safety — close 14 gaps surfaced by the 2026-05-13 code audit
goal: Close the trading-correctness, safety-control, and operator-visibility gaps the 2026-05-13 src/tui/ code audit surfaced. The bot is currently halted. Every story here is a precondition for safe unhalt OR a visibility fix the operator needs to make the unhalt decision honestly. Doc-defined backlog is empty (all spec'd TUI features shipped); this PRD is the audit's residual debt — fakes that look live, modals that don't fire, hotkey collisions that could destroy live trades, silent reconnect failures, sparse error surfaces.
context: 2026-05-13 audit (one Plan-agent pass across src/tui/app.py + 17 screens + 8 widgets + data_provider.py + theme.tcss) found ~20 gaps. Top 14 ranked by impact: D1 fake random.uniform spread in TradesDrillDown (operator's flatten decision relies on a lie), A6 _start_veto_countdown defined but never called (US-511 pre-trade abort window is dead in live mode), A4 action_supervisor_abort has no confirmation modal (one mis-key vetoes live execution), A5/D4/H1 global a/c/r hotkey shadowing (could trigger destructive global action when operator believes they're acting on current screen), L3 OANDA disconnect mid-session leaves TUI calling dead client (no auto-reconnect; operator forced into Ctrl+R restart). All fixes are reversible, additive, and exercise the existing TUI invariants without touching the trading hot path.

agent_policy: FORBIDDEN: 'general-purpose' agent. Any sub-agent call MUST specify a subagent_type from the agent_roster below.
Every story MUST invoke a primary specialist for IMPLEMENTATION and a distinct specialist for REVIEW.
Ralph MUST NOT mark a story complete until both implementation and review agents have signed off in `notes` with timestamp.
If a story needs a capability not in the roster, Ralph MUST HALT and escalate rather than defaulting to general-purpose.
code_quality: NO MOCK CODE. No unittest.mock, MagicMock, patch, or test-double class. Tests use real ScannerConfig, real ConfigAdjuster(persistence_path=tmp_path / 'x.json'), real disk via tmp_path. (.claude/rules/improvement.md No-Mock Rule, promoted 2026-05-01)
All JSON file writes MUST be atomic: write to .tmp, then os.rename. (.claude/rules/improvement.md JSON Safety Gates)
All JSON file reads MUST be wrapped in try/except with graceful fallback to empty dict/list.
NEVER use bare except: or except Exception: pass — always log + re-raise or return explicit error status.
All OANDA API calls MUST use exponential backoff (base 1s, max 30s, jitter) with explicit timeouts (connect=5s, read=30s). NEVER retry on 4xx — only 5xx/timeout/connection errors.
Specific exception types, not Exception, for narrow recoverable errors.
Type hints on all new public APIs. mypy must remain clean on touched files.
tui_policy: All destructive actions (kill, mode→live, abort signal, reject adjustment) MUST show a confirmation modal with typed confirmation or double-tap.
All TUI writes to backend state MUST be audit-logged to .claude/brain/strategic_log.md with ISO timestamp, actor='TUI', action, before/after values.
State flags (halted, scanner_paused, mode) MUST persist in .claude/state.json and survive TUI restart.
TUI MUST NEVER block the event loop on OANDA calls — use Textual @work workers.
Live-mode widgets MUST NEVER display synthetic/random values. If real data is unavailable, show '—' or 'no data' placeholder, never a plausible-looking number.
completion_discipline: A story is NOT complete until ALL validation_commands exit 0 AND all definition_of_done checks pass.
Ralph MUST emit <promise>COMPLETE_STORY_{id}</promise> only AFTER validation_commands have been executed and evidence logged in notes.
A story that cannot pass validation MUST have passes stay false and notes updated with blocker reason.
No story may be marked complete based on 'should work' reasoning — only on recorded evidence.

agent_roster.note: Subagent_type values match .claude/agents/*.md file stems. Verified 2026-05-13.

frontend_developer.use_for: All Textual TUI screens, widgets, hotkeys, modals, TCSS theming, BINDINGS lists

senior_developer.use_for: data_provider.py wiring, OANDA reconnect logic, dataclass extensions, event-bus subscriptions

backend_architect.use_for: Service boundaries when a fix needs threading through scanner→data_provider→TUI

code_reviewer.use_for: Mandatory review of every code change. Checks: no-mock, atomic writes, no bare except, type hints, error handling.

security_engineer.use_for: Review of any path that moves money, halts trading, or vetoes a signal (US-003, US-004, US-005)

api_tester.use_for: OANDA integration tests (reconnect, live spread fetch)

reality_checker.use_for: Final sign-off — 'does this actually do what the story says when ./buddy --demo boots and the operator presses the key?'

userStories.title: Wire _start_veto_countdown to event_bus.signal.pending subscription
userStories.description: src/tui/app.py:1974-1995 defines _start_veto_countdown which renders an `EXECUTING {pair} in {n}s… A to abort` countdown banner. `grep _start_veto_countdown src/tui/app.py` returns only its definition — no callers. US-511 pre-trade veto window is dead in live mode. Subscribe to event_bus signal.pending in on_mount; call _start_veto_countdown per event with the configured veto window duration (default 5s, configurable via ScannerConfig.pre_trade_veto_seconds).

supporting_agents.name: Security Engineer
supporting_agents.role: Confirm the abort window cannot be bypassed by rapid signal arrival; confirm countdown teardown is idempotent

acceptanceCriteria: BuddyTUI.on_mount subscribes to event_bus signal.pending events via a Textual @work async worker.
Each signal.pending event invokes self._start_veto_countdown(pair, direction, duration_s) with duration from getattr(config, 'pre_trade_veto_seconds', 5).
If a second signal.pending arrives before the prior countdown ends, the prior countdown is cancelled cleanly (no zombie timers).
Countdown banner is mounted via existing brain-feed widget OR a new pinned banner widget (Frontend Developer picks; document choice in notes).
On abort (`a` key during countdown window), the published event is control.signal_veto with signal_id; on countdown completion without abort, no event is published (scanner proceeds independently).
Test at tests/test_tui_veto_countdown.py uses real EventBus, publishes signal.pending, asserts _start_veto_countdown is called within 100ms. NO MOCKS.
Typecheck passes.

userStories.title: data_provider — OANDA auto-reconnect on transient disconnect
userStories.description: src/tui/data_provider.py:189-209 connect() is only called once at boot. If OANDA disconnects mid-session, _do_live_refresh keeps calling a dead client. Header shows OANDA OFF but no auto-reconnect; operator forced to Ctrl+R. Add reconnect-with-backoff inside _do_live_refresh when self.oanda_connected is False: attempt connect() at increasing intervals (5s, 10s, 30s, 60s, capped 60s).

supporting_agents.name: API Tester
supporting_agents.role: Drive a disconnect/reconnect cycle against the OANDA practice endpoint

acceptanceCriteria: data_provider tracks self._reconnect_attempts: int and self._next_reconnect_at: datetime.
_do_live_refresh, when self.oanda_connected is False, attempts self._oanda.connect() only if now() >= self._next_reconnect_at.
Backoff schedule: 5s, 10s, 30s, 60s, 60s, 60s … (cap at 60s after 4 attempts). Reset on successful reconnect.
Each attempt logs to brain feed at INFO with attempt number and delay. Success logs at INFO 'OANDA reconnected'.
Header indicator flips OANDA OFF → OANDA ON on success.

Integration test at tests/test_tui_data_provider_reconnect.py (marked `@pytest.mark.integration` since it touches OANDA) drives: (a) connect succeeds, (b) simulate disconnect by stopping the OANDA client, (c) refresh fires reconnect attempt, (d) reconnect succeeds and header reflects it. NO MOCKS — uses real OANDA practice creds via env or skip if creds absent.
Typecheck passes.
definition_of_done: All validation_commands exit 0 (integration test may be skipped if OANDA creds absent; that is acceptable but must log SKIP, not FAIL).
